name: @ahpd/bot
description: Bots for ahpd. Each bot has its own identity, workspace and sessions.
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Bot
ahpd.description: Create bots with their own identity, workspace and persistent sessions.

root.description: Folder for bot workspaces, one '<root>/<slug>' per bot. Defaults to '~/.bots'. Cannot be inside the configuration folder.

mainTurnPostMessageAbsent.description: What the bot's chat shows when its work session ends without post_message. 'post' (default) shows the session's last words; 'notice' shows a notice; 'silence' shows nothing; 'postNotice' shows the last words, or the notice when there are none.

instructionsIn.description: Where the bot's instructions are in its AGENTS.md. 'section' (default) reads its '## Instructions' section; 'body' reads the whole body after the frontmatter.

contextIn.description: Where a woken message's context goes. 'text' (default) adds a block before the person's words with the main chat, the person and the time; 'meta' sends the words as said, with the main chat in the message's delegation _meta.

askIn.description: Where the work session's questions and approvals appear. 'main' (default) copies them into the main chat to answer there; 'own' leaves them in the work session's chat and lists them on the main chat's inputNeeded.
